d:
"Every abandoned dog deserves a chance to feel safe, loved and wanted. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres and her team take on challenging dog rescue cases, helping stray, injured and sick pit bulls get the care and attention they need. Behind every rescue is a story of survival, trust and the hope of finding a loving family.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 11, Episodes 9, 14, 5, 1, 8, 4 and 7, on Animal Planet India."
